description: Desktop AI assistant for running local language models and managing private, model-powered chats.
notes: Review status: the official v0.8.8 x64 and ARM64 Windows setup assets and their SHA-256 digests are verified. The upstream Windows bundle configuration targets NSIS and MSI, but the release assets used here are the architecture-specific setup EXEs.

This manifest downloads the setup only and intentionally declares no shim or shortcut. Keep it under review until the Windows installer behavior is inspected and tested.
